label: Finding-98
title: release-moved: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: Release actually shipped before 14:00 UTC; story.json says 'at 14:00 UTC': The schedule was 14:00 UTC, but the GHSAs show 13:34Z, Wiz posted at 13:32:25Z (decoded), CERT-EU says '13:30 UTC' and CybelAngel 'about 13:35 UTC'. story.json's lead says 'On 21 October 2026 at 14:00 UTC the PHP project released fixes'. The claim (schedule moved) is right; the lead sentence is not.
